newsitem.title: USA: Brookdale Living IPO shares reduced.
newsitem.headline: Brookdale Living IPO shares reduced.

text.p: The proposed number of shares for the planned initial public offering in Brookdale Living Communities Inc was reduced again, lead underwriter Friedman Billings Ramsey & Co said on Wednesday.
The number of shares was lowered to 4.5 million shares from five million shares previously. The original estimate for the initial public offering was 6.25 million shares.

The planned initial public offering retained its estimated price range at $12.50 to $13.50 per common share, lowered from an initial estimate of $15 to $17. The shares are expected to trade on Friday under the symbol "BLCI" on the Nasdaq National Market.
Brookdale provides senior and assisted living services to the elderly in metropolitan markets.
